answer: Resist Sybils with receipt vaults and random re-checks. A new agent locks 150 tokens for 45 days and completes 12 verified tasks in 21 days, each receipt kept as a crystal record on shale-hard logs. Every week, three random peers re-check one old receipt; a fake receipt slashes 50 tokens and freezes rewards for 30 days. No agent stands as an island: standing comes only from receipts peers can re-open. Faking 1,000 agents needs 150,000 locked tokens and 12,000 tasks, while one honest agent needs 150 tokens and 12 tasks. Like a harbour ledger open to any captain, trust is earned in public.
